English: Timber Store
A rudimentary storage shelter of timber and earth, hastily constructed to protect vital supplies on the frontier.
Stone Storehouse
A solid stone storehouse replaces makeshift shelters, securing provisions against fire and theft.
Secure Storehouse
An improved storehouse with reinforced doors and basic watch, offering better protection for stored goods and arms.
Expanded Store
Subterranean chambers and outer storage sheds dramatically increase capacity, supporting larger garrisons and longer sieges.
Guarded Storehouse
Dedicated guards and fortified access make this storehouse a last bastion in times of siege, ensuring critical supplies remain protected.
Large Storehouse
A complex of stone granaries and armories ensures the castle can withstand prolonged blockades while supporting ever-larger forces.
Supplies Depot
A large and organized depot for military and civilian supplies, featuring secure vaults and administrative offices.
Warehouse
A vast stone warehouse with guarded chambers for grain, arms, and valuables, supporting grand feudal operations.
Reinforced Warehouse
With double-thick walls, iron-barred vaults, and a permanent garrison, this warehouse is prepared for any siege or disaster.
Grand Storehouse
The ultimate storage complex, with massive granaries, armories, and treasury halls, guarded by elite retainers and supporting a true seat of power.
